worldcombat.skill.guardsplit.summary: Temporarily averages both bodies’ defenses. Pokémon share Defense and Special Defense; ordinary bodies contribute their armor, including equipment.
worldcombat.skill.guardsplit.use.0: Raise your thin defence to the foe's thickness
worldcombat.skill.guardsplit.use.1: Shave the foe's wall down to yours
worldcombat.skill.guardsplit.use.2: Close the gap when the foe is far tougher
worldcombat.skill.guardsplit.description: Average Defense and Sp. Def with a target within %1$s blocks, held for %2$s; a clear line is required.
Equipment armor is included for ordinary bodies; ability stages remain separate. This change is removed when the effect ends or is cleared.
worldcombat.skill.guardsplit.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP to split, then %3$s seconds to recover and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.guardsplit.growth.0: At level %1$s the split reaches %2$s blocks and the window lasts %3$s seconds.
worldcombat.skill.guardsplit.growth.1: At level %1$s the split reaches %2$s blocks and the window lasts %3$s seconds.
The companion only splits when the threat is within this distance; lower stays close, higher chases the gap down.
The foe's combined raw Defense and Sp. Def must reach this multiple of yours. Higher is pickier and only splits against a clearly tougher foe; lower casts more often.
On: it leaves its station under a hold order to split. Off: it only casts when the target is already in reach.
